text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the meeting, I noticed Duramente
pulling out a container with food inside.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...? Ah, it's chicken tenderloin.
I made it as a snack.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Mmph... No good.
It's dry and not tasty.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Did I overheat it? ...I forgot to taste-test it too.
One shouldn't daydream while cooking...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could her fatigue be from racing so frequently?
I should probably re-evaluate her racing schedule.
